text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: loose leaves in green, red-purple and bronze tones, some ruffled and glossy, some flat and matte, spread across most of the upper and left plate, with pale green pea-shoot or rocket-like stems; piece size roughly 3-8 cm per leaf, lightly moist, no visible dressing sheen, leaves piled about 2-3 cm high | 120
ITEM 2 | Cubes of pale off-white soft solid, matte surface with slightly irregular edges, about 2-2.5 cm per side, four visible pieces sitting on top of and among the greens, firm-looking and non-glossy | 60
ITEM 3 | Green beans or long green pods, bright green, smooth, slightly glossy, two to three stalks about 10-12 cm long and 1 cm thick, lying diagonally across the centre-right of the plate beside the eggplant | 35
ITEM 4 | Grilled eggplant pieces: dark purple-brown skin with charred black grill marks and browned, slightly caramelised cut surfaces, irregular chunks about 2-4 cm, clustered on the lower-right of the plate, moderately soft with a glossy sheen | 85
ITEM 5 | Thin pale pink-red slivers or leaf fragments, matte, about 3-4 cm long, scattered among the greens on the upper left | 5
